title: Birdwatching rewires the brain and slows cognitive decline
why_read: An interesting popular-science finding about birdwatching and cognition, but it's not a technical or engineering topic.
analysis: This item reports on research suggesting that birdwatching as a hobby may have measurable cognitive benefits, likely tied to attention, outdoor activity, and mindfulness effects. It's a neuroscience/health story rather than anything related to software or systems engineering. It may appeal to general curiosity but has no direct relevance to a technical digest's core audience.
